description: This PHP source file contains a unit test class 'ImapTestSettingsEntryHandlerTest' that tests the behavior of the 'ImapTestSettingsEntryHandler' class. The test class includes multiple test methods to verify different scenarios of handling entry point requests related to IMAP test settings within a CRM system extension.

classes.name: ImapTestSettingsEntryHandlerTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class for testing the ImapTestSettingsEntryHandler class methods and behaviors.

methods.name: testHandleEntryPointRequestWrongConfig
methods.description: Tests that handleEntryPointRequest throws an InvalidArgumentException when 'sugar_config' does not contain 'imap_test' parameter.

methods.name: testHandleEntryPointRequestWrongRequest
methods.description: Tests that handleEntryPointRequest throws an InvalidArgumentException when '$_REQUEST' does not contain 'imap_test_settings'.

methods.name: testHandleEntryPointRequestWrongKey
methods.description: Tests that handleEntryPointRequest returns an error message when the specified key is not found in the settings.

methods.name: testHandleEntryPointRequest
methods.description: Tests the success case where handleEntryPointRequest updates the settings and returns a confirmation message, and then deletes the settings file.
